digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py, src/rebar/llm/runner.py — Bedrock model capability overrides and structured output plumbing
propositions: native_structured_output is globally forced False for all Claude/Bedrock models via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, but E1 measurement proved it works on specific cells under extended thinking

Enable native structured output for exactly the two measured Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive thinking, dated haiku 4-5) by adding rows to _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES with native_structured_output: True and native_output_with_thinking: True

native_output_with_thinking field is dropped/defaults to False on all three ModelCapabilities construction paths (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, and _intersect_capabilities) so overrides setting it True are silently ignored

Plumb native_output_with_thinking through all three ModelCapabilities construction sites: seed it in both capabilities.py dicts and pass it in constructor calls; add conservative all(...) intersection in _intersect_capabilities for FallbackModel chains
opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected server-side by Converse structured output under thinking and remain fail-closed; only the two E1-measured cells get enablement rows
String-fallback path (bedrock:model-id format) and FallbackModel chain intersection must both preserve native-output-with-thinking capability from overrides when all candidates support it
